_comment: Region 1 story registry: every id a quest step may reference. lint_quests.gd checks each step and dialogue against this file, cast.json, data/items.json and data/world/first_region.json. Places marked status 'c0' or 'c1' are new names from REGION_1_PLAN.md that the cloud session (C0 canon data, C1 layout) will place; 'pos' is the proposed [x, z] in metres from Ashford (north is -z) and C1 may move them. Keep ids stable: saves store them.

kingsreach_council_hall.name: Hall of the Council of Wardens

stones._comment: Runestones a step can name. kind road = a RARunestoneNetwork road stone (C3 maps the id to the nearest stone to 'place'); kind elder = one of the five Elder Stone hubs (L7 wardlines budgets). greenhollow_road is a group: any stone on that road counts.

wolf.what: Grey wolf (existing wolf.gd); the safe first fight is one lone wolf

antlered_warden.what: Stagborn guardian miniboss; subdue, never kill (X3)

stagborn_fawn.what: Thistle, the stagborn fawn the wolf hunts in Act I (L5 stagborn model scaled down; follow/nuzzle behaviour X3). Never a kill target

scarbound_troll.what: Finale boss at the Rift mouth (X6)

cutscenes.blessing: Age-12 Blessing at the Ashford ring (C9)
cutscenes.elder_relight: An Elder Stone relights; ward-lines race out across the map (C9, played for each hub)
cutscenes.rowan_ember: Sir Rowan's ember rises at Highwatch (C9, short)
cutscenes.finale_seal: The Rift mouth closes; glimpse of the Ember and Bloom Rifts (C9)
cutscenes.region_complete: Homecoming at Ashford, the Kindling lanterns a year on, and the 'Region 1 complete' card (C9)
cutscenes.herd_crossing: Act II dawn: the Stagborn herd walks the old ward-line across the Greenhollow road; Thistle hears them (C9, 15 s)
cutscenes.maren_last_stand: Act III Kindling Night: Maren holds the Ashford heart-stone lit by hand; her ember sinks in and the ring turns gold (C9, 30 s)

new_items._comment: Items the story gives that are not in data/items.json yet (C7 adds them).

rowan_lance.name: Rowan's Lance
rowan_lance.note: Heirloom when Rowan's ember goes to the lance (N3)

maren_staff.name: Maren's Staff
maren_staff.note: Heirloom from Maren Coldbrook (Act IV vigil). Her ember rests in the Ashford heart-stone

choice_groups._comment: Mutually exclusive player choices. 'source' says who sets the flag: dialogue (a dialogue choice 'do' sets it; lint checks) or a system (ember_choice UI from L13/C5). The lint autoplay walks every combination. Where it matters the first flag is the 'giving' option, so the lint's first diagonal run (every group's first flag) plays the hidden Kindled Dawn ending.

external_flags._comment: Flags set outside Region 1 story data that the story reads. Prefix match when the key ends with ':'.
external_flags.ember.has_ancestor: ember_legacy.gd (L10): a previous character of this family rests in a stone

exported_flags._comment: Story flags other systems read (so the lint does not call them unused).
exported_flags.r1.a1.first_glyph: C8 onboarding metric: a new player reaches the first glyph in 20 minutes or less
exported_flags.r1.complete: Region 1 complete: post-game unlock, achievements, C9 card
exported_flags.r1.a1.wren_joined: Retinue (C20, RETINUE_SETTLEMENT_ASCENSION.md 2.8): Wren Coldbrook joins as the first companion (Follow/Standby)
exported_flags.r1.a1.thistle_named: Taming (C20): Thistle the stagborn fawn is the player's first bonded beast
exported_flags.r1.a3.maren_gone: Maren Coldbrook is dead (her ember rests in the Ashford heart-stone); the Staff Yard passes to Wren
exported_flags.r1.ending.kindled: Hidden best ending (achievement): nobody else pays at the Rift mouth

music._comment: Music cues a step's 'staging' may name (lint checks). Existing files: docs/regions/AUDIO_R1.md. 'missing' cues need sourcing (L17 follow-up); until then C12 plays the fallback.

silence.note: fade the bed out over 1.5 s; ambience and SFX only

r1_kindling.want: festival lantern theme: fiddle and hand-drum, warm, a little wistful

r1_lament.want: grief theme: solo fiddle or low whistle over a drone, 90 s loop

r1_finale.want: finale theme: the village_day melody rebuilt big for strings and drums
